content: Mu tunaka'oedyukudu ka Judea mee naneadu teepu-koobatu mu naka ka mu wakwawa'a Te Naa unnena mu naka'oedyukute.
Ka Peter Jerusalem-wi petugase, susumudu mu Jew numu-matu Te Pabe'e-wi tunaka'oedyukudu oo nesootze'ma,
meeoo yise oo netamma, “U gi te tumayohope mayoho u ka mu wakwawa'a-baa petugase, umu-no tuka.”
Soo Peter yise no'oko tu manepu mu tuukwe, mee unakwe,
“Nu ka oona Joppa mee naneadu-kwi'yoona nanesootuha'e. Ka nanesootuhina nu meeoo tuusoobedyana heegina tubongo ka teepu-koobatoo pa'anakwana wuegena.
Ka oo wue petuse nanakumma'yoosoo hee oe'yoona sa'we petuhoo: togogwa, nunu'u, nanakumma'yoosoo kwe'na'a nu oo poonne.
Nuka meeoo netamma, ‘Yabe mu batsase, mu tuka.’
Nu yise meeoo, ‘Gi numme putoogoo meana. Nu gi mownnekoo tukadu.’
Meeoo yise e netamma, ‘Soo Te Naa esoo besa'yoo, gi suta'yoo soo Te Naa ka meeoo unnena.’
Toge pahe nu meeoo natuukwe. No'yoona soo hee toogoopa nahanegapu, mee nu tuusoobedyana.
Yabesoo pahe'yoo nanana petugono ka nobe e pukwi'yoopu-wi ka Caesarea mee naneadu-kwi'yoona umuoo natayapu. Umuoo yise petugono punowsoo e bigeakwuse.
Soo Te Naa Besa Pooha meeoo e netamma, ‘Gi tunetutzeapana. Umu-no mea.’ Nu yise mu naapihoo tunaka'oedyukudu-no mea. Numme yise mu wakwawa'a nobe-kwi petuga.
Oosoo meeoo mee tuukwe'e, ‘Soo Te Naa tummatziwabe oo nobe-kwi oo-baa petugase meeoo oo netamma, “Tooe haka tooe sakwa ka Joppa mee naneadu-kwitu ka Simon Peter mee naneadu bitooa.
Soo Simon Peter ka petuse, mu tuukwetooa soo Te Naa unnepu yise ka mu nobe-kwitu, mu tummatziwabe nokosoo mu magwetzoitooa,” mee'e soo Te Naa tummatziwabe.’
Nu yise oetu mu tuukwe'e tooesoo e yadooawunu Te Naa Besa Pooha umu-ma mani petu. Ka o'nosoo tukwa'nesoo tamme ooka wumakwusoo.
Nu yise oo sooma'yu ka o'nosoo Te Pabe'e Jesus tamme netammapu, ‘Soo John baa-wi mu matzaka pana Te Naa yise eka tu Besa Pooha-matu-ma mu sootuhi,’ mee'e.
Soo Te Naa yise ka Tu Besa Pooha-matu-ma mu sootuhi ka Te Pabe'e Jesus te oedyukute. Meno'o punno'o tamme-wa'nesoo, ka Te Naa Besa Pooha-ma nasootuhipu. Nu gi ka Te Naa tumoo'oo-wa'ne'yoo uweoo.”
Umu ka Peter tumoo'oodu, uga, oo nakase gi hanotusoo hayoo unne-wa'ne'yoo, ka Te Naa nesootuhina meeoo umu unakwe, “Yise meno'o mu wakwawa'a atasoo tu manena yugwese soo Te Naa mu magwetzoikwu.”

Ka Stephen nabatsase ewa'yoo mu tunaka'oedyukudu mea ka mu numu pumme nehowa'e. Susumudu kwenaha-tamme ka tubetse baa kumi me'a Phoenicia mee naneadu teepu-koobatoo susumudu Cyprus-witoo natsemangega, umu-matu tuwow Antioch mee naneadu-kwitoo me'a ka meana ka Te Pabe'e-witu mu Jew numu tuukwe me'a.
Pana umu-matoo ka mu wakwawa'a teepu Cyprus noko Cyrene mee nananeadu-witoo nadooamudoo, ka Antioch-wi petugase, mu wakwawa'a punno'o oetu natuukwe'e.
Ka ooka mu waha Te Naa mu sootuhi. Ewa'yoo wakwawa'a mu nakana oo naka'oedyukute ka Te Pabe'e-witu.
Mu tunaka'oedyukudu tooesoo Jerusalem-wi'yoona umu-witu nakase, sumuoo nana Barnabas mee naneadu umu-matoo ta'ya. Ka Antioch-wi ka Barnabas petugase
umu oo poonne ka ewow numu oo sootuha'e. Soo Barnabas besa umu-matoo soonammena ka Te Naa ooosapa naka'oedyukuna oo tumayohokuna.
Soo Barnabas besa'yoo nana; unu tunaka'oedyukuna, ka Te Naa Besa Pooha hee-ga'yoo, ka saa'a mu tunaka'oedyukudu ewa manega.
Soo Barnabas ka Paul watena Tarsus mee naneadu-kwi petuga. Soo Paul uga Saul mee naneadu.

Oo mayuse punowsoo oo bika Antioch-witoo. Sumu tommo mu Barnabas-no Paul ka mu tunaka'oedyukudu tunedyooena ewow numu noko, yow ka Antioch-wi'yoona mu tunaka'oedyukudu, “Te Pabe'e nakanagemo'odu,” mee umu naneapu.
O'no yise umu Te Naa-witu numu tunedyooedu Jerusalem-wi'yoona ka Antioch-wi petuga.

Sumu'yoo umu-matu Agabus mee naneadu 'wunuhoose ka Te Naa Besa Pooha wumana meeoo mu tuukwe, “Pudusoo no'yoona ka teepu-koobatu numu tseagoekwu.” Soo Te Naa unnepu oo-toogoo mani ka Claudius mee naneadu numu-kobena oo katu.
Mu tunaka'oedyukudu Antioch-witu ka mu Judea-witu tunaka'oedyukudu tumasumutookute. Tu mapu'a noko umu mu haneku.
Mu Barnabas-no Paul oo hanegase, umu tunaka'oedyukudu moohedu ka Judea-witu haneku.
